{{Top}}
'''Prefabricated ground bases''' were bases used for medical activity, troop [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], an [[Armory/Legends|armory]], or, most frequently, a ground-vehicle parking bay. Some such bases were armed with point-defense cannons, but it was more practical to have [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] as their main defense. The [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] was the main defense of some such bases, although not all had them, and any hostile being or object could walk through the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]. The [[Galactic Empire]] addressed this weakness with the [[IM-8005 shield projector garrison]]. Its shield could expand to 2,600 kilometers and retract when needed.
